name: Default
shortDescription: Lightweight file sharing server with expiring download links, file requests and optional end-to-end encryption, using SQLite and local storage.

alerts.message: Open https://<your-domain>/setup right after deploying and finish the setup wizard: until it is completed the wizard is reachable without authentication. Set the Public Facing URL to https://<your-domain>/, leave Use SSL disabled (HTTPS is handled in front of the app) and create the admin account there.
